name: Deathlurker's Cloak — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Deathlurker's Cloak from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Cloak, Deathlurker’s" but are not part of the Deathlurker's Cloak entry, which is unchanged.

Aura faint necromancy; CL 3rd

Slot shoulders; Price 2,700 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This drab gray cloak sometimes billows about on an invisible wind.

Once per day, you may use doom, which causes a deathlike shadow to cross your face for a moment.

This item has an associated deity.

If you worship the associated deity, once per day you may use false life. While false life is active, if you coup de grace a dying foe, your temporary hit points from the spell increase by 1 (to a maximum of 20 temporary hit points). The dispatched creature must have at least as many hit dice as you for this effect to occur.
